comments.value: This has been addressed by the SDK v3.3.0 released today!

details:
`_updateCancelButton` can be null if we did not open the builder page of control panel and we upload from the API but `FinishUpload`  assumes `_updateCancelButton` is not null which is not true so `NullReferenceException` can be happened.
